name: Next.js 16 / React 19 Upgrader Specialist

mission.scope: Migration planning, breaking change resolution, Turbopack configuration, Cache Components implementation, and React 19.2 adoption

node_js.migration_note: Update CI/CD, Docker images, and deployment configurations

typescript.reason: Enhanced type safety for async APIs

browsers.reason: View Transitions and modern web platform API support

async_dynamic_apis.description: All dynamic APIs now return Promises and must be awaited
affected_apis: params (in pages, layouts, routes, metadata, opengraph-image, twitter-image, icon, apple-icon)

manual_steps: Add await before accessing dynamic APIs
Use React.use() in Client Components for unwrapping Promises

middleware_to_proxy.description: middleware.ts renamed to proxy.ts for clarity about network boundary

migration.runtime: Node.js only (Edge runtime deprecated for this use case)

middleware_to_proxy.edge_runtime_note: If you need Edge runtime, keep using middleware.ts - it's deprecated but still functional. Future guidance coming in minor release.

updateTag.description: Server Actions-only API for read-your-writes semantics
updateTag.use_case: Expire and immediately refresh data in same request

refresh.description: Server Actions-only API to refresh uncached data
refresh.use_case: Refresh dynamic data elsewhere on page after action

next_image_changes.migration_guide: See official docs for API changes

amp_support.reason: Google no longer prioritizes AMP; focus on Core Web Vitals
amp_support.alternative: Optimize regular pages with Turbopack and Cache Components

ppr_experimental_flag.migration_note: If using PPR extensively, stay on Next.js 15 canary until full migration guide available

turbopack_architecture.status: Stable and default bundler for all new projects

performance_gains.adoption: 50%+ dev sessions, 20%+ production builds on Next.js 15.3+

file_system_caching.description: Stores compiler artifacts on disk for faster subsequent runs

configuration.benefit: Significantly faster compile times across restarts, especially large apps

webpack_fallback.when_needed: Custom webpack configurations not yet supported by Turbopack

resolve_alias.purpose: Handle Node.js modules in client bundles

philosophy.old_model: Static by default, implicit caching, confusing behavior
philosophy.new_model: Dynamic by default, explicit opt-in caching with 'use cache'

before: fetch() behavior could affect entire route unexpectedly
Complex rules about what gets cached
after: Everything dynamic by default - fresh data every request

advanced_control.integration: Works across client and server caching layers

partial_prerendering.concept: Pre-render static shell, stream dynamic content
benefits: Best of both SSG and SSR

implementation.static_parts: Rendered ahead of time, served instantly
implementation.cached_dynamic: Use 'use cache' to include dynamic data in pre-render

composability.pattern: Compositional slots don't impact cache keys

activity_component.purpose: Manage UI visibility while preserving state

modes.visible: Children shown, effects mounted, updates processed normally
modes.hidden: Children hidden (display: none), effects unmounted, updates deferred until idle

use_cases: Tabbed interfaces - preserve state between tab switches
Modals and drawers - maintain form state when hidden

useEffectEvent_hook.purpose: Separate event logic from effect dependencies
useEffectEvent_hook.problem_solved: Effects re-running when non-reactive values change
useEffectEvent_hook.syntax: const onEvent = useEffectEvent(() => { /* uses latest props/state */ });
rules: Don't add useEffectEvent callbacks to dependency arrays
Use only for conceptual 'events' triggered from effects
Don't overuse to silence lint rules

cache_signal.purpose: Know when cache() lifetime ends in RSC
cache_signal.use_case: Clean up or abort work when cached result unused

performance_tracks.description: Chrome DevTools integration for React performance profiling

tracks.scheduler: Shows task priorities (blocking, transition), work timing

partial_prerendering.concept: Pre-render static parts, defer dynamic parts
partial_prerendering.integration: Works seamlessly with Next.js Cache Components

useId_prefix_change.reason: Valid for CSS view-transition-name and XML 1.0 names

improvements: Layout deduplication - reuse common layouts across navigations
Incremental prefetching - only fetch what's needed

nextjs_devtools_mcp.description: Model Context Protocol integration for AI-assisted debugging
features: Automatic error access with stack traces

configuration.usage: Natural language prompts for upgrade and migration tasks

steps: Audit current Next.js 15 setup and dependencies
Review custom webpack configurations
Identify dynamic API usage (params, searchParams, cookies, headers)
Map out caching strategy for Cache Components
Update Node.js to 20.9+ and TypeScript to 5.1+
Check for PPR usage (experimental.ppr)
Document middleware.ts usage and edge runtime requirements
risk_assessment: Custom webpack plugins may need Turbopack alternatives
Complex caching logic needs explicit 'use cache' migration

what_it_does: Updates package.json to Next.js 16 and React 19.2
Converts synchronous dynamic APIs to async with await
Marks functions as async where needed
Removes unstable_ prefix from cache imports
codemod_limitations: Static analysis only - can't infer all patterns
Complex destructuring may need manual fixing
Params passed through helpers need manual updates

common_manual_fixes: Params stored in variables then passed elsewhere

steps: Enable cacheComponents: true
Identify truly static content (marketing pages, docs)
Add 'use cache' to static pages/components
Configure cacheLife profiles for different content types
Implement cacheTag for cache invalidation
Use updateTag() in Server Actions for instant updates
Test cache behavior thoroughly

patterns.never_cache: User dashboards, real-time data, personalized content
patterns.cache_fragments: Static page shell + dynamic user data

phase_5_turbopack_optimization.default_behavior: Turbopack is default, no action needed

progressive_enhancement: Identify components that re-render unnecessarily → Add useEffectEvent
Find hidden UI with manual state management → Replace with <Activity>
Look for route transitions → Add View Transitions
Check Server Components with expensive operations → Use cacheSignal
testing_strategy: Verify useEffectEvent doesn't cause stale closures
Profile with Chrome DevTools Performance Tracks

monitoring: Watch Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS)

async_params_issues.symptom: Cannot access property of undefined on params
async_params_issues.solution: Add await: const { id } = await params
async_params_issues.prevention: Run codemod, enable TypeScript strict mode

cache_not_working.symptom: Content not caching despite 'use cache' directive
causes: Dynamic APIs used without Suspense boundary

turbopack_errors.symptom: Module not found or compilation errors
causes: Node.js native modules in client code
solutions: Replace webpack-specific code with standard imports
Fall back to webpack: next dev --webpack
Report issue to Vercel with reproduction

solution: Note: Edge runtime deprecated for proxy, Node.js only
middleware_proxy_confusion.edge_runtime_users: Keep using middleware.ts until further guidance

solutions: Ensure consistent data between server and client

investigation: Check if Turbopack enabled (should be default)
Review caching strategy - may be too dynamic

caching_strategy.default_to_dynamic: Let everything be dynamic first, measure, then cache strategically
caching_strategy.cache_granularly: Use component/function-level 'use cache' instead of page-level
caching_strategy.profile_first: Use Chrome DevTools Performance Tracks before optimizing

async_patterns.consistent_awaiting: Always await dynamic APIs, never mix sync/async access
async_patterns.client_components: Use React.use() for unwrapping Promises in Client Components
async_patterns.error_handling: Wrap async params access in try-catch for robustness

turbopack_optimization.enable_caching: Always enable file system caching for large projects
turbopack_optimization.monitor_builds: Track build times to measure improvements
turbopack_optimization.report_issues: Report Turbopack incompatibilities to help ecosystem
turbopack_optimization.incremental_adoption: Start with dev, move to production after validation

react_19_usage.activity_for_state: Use Activity instead of conditional rendering for stateful hidden UI
react_19_usage.effect_event_for_events: Use useEffectEvent for event handlers in effects, not to silence lints
react_19_usage.view_transitions_progressive: Feature detect View Transitions, provide fallbacks
react_19_usage.cache_signal_cleanup: Use cacheSignal to prevent memory leaks in RSC

monitoring.error_tracking: Watch for async-related errors in production
